name: [🎃HALLOWEEN🎃] Ego Piece
desc:
Anime Ego Piece is a fan-made game featuring many anime characters.

The anime Ego Piece was inspired by games like Blox Fruit, Verse Piece, and Anime Spirit.

⭐Level Cap: 1000

⚔️ Swords in our game: Sharp Shadow, Yoru, Toji, SJW, Levi, Aizen , Atomic, Kokushibo, Tanjiro, SJW V2, CID V2, ANOS!

👊 Combats in our game: Boxer, Itadori, Midoriya, Toilet, Okarun, Akaza, ULQUIORRA, JAJANKEN!

🔥 Specials (EGO): Naruto, Yuno, Escanor, Meliodas, Gojo, Sukuna, Enjin, Rudo, Mob, Cosmic Garou, GOJO V2, SUKUNA V2

👍Don't forget to like our game and add it to your favorites!👍

Codes are available on our Discord Server!!

CONTROLS:
W,A,S,D - WALK
M - Open Menu
Q - DASH
CTRL - SPRINT
DOUBLE SPACE - DOUBLE JUMP
G - HAKI
E - INVENTORY
Z,X,C,V - SKILL
